status: locked 2026-11-04 before any test run (user decision 2026-11-04: run both analyses with GPT-6-Luna only); test runs use exactly these files

questions.S5_no_record_locations: Does the result of the locked design depend on the one addition to the moved information, the 'Records:' sentence of each terminology entry (FHIR resource type and search field)?
questions.S6_goal_paraphrase: Does the result of the goal-only instruction depend on the single goal wording of each family?

design_unchanged: The locked source (results/design-lock/lock.json, src/*.py) is not edited. sensitivity/run_followup.py replaces in memory the terminology entries and the terminology search description (S5) or the goal template and topics (S6), then calls clinical_agent.run.main; sensitivity/followup.json holds the variants.

conditions.S0: Locked design (existing runs <arm>-test-150-rep1 to -rep3 on GPT-6-Luna).
conditions.S5_no_record_locations: Each terminology entry without its 'Records:' sentence; the terminology search description without the clause on resource type and search field. Codes, protocols, order catalog, prompt and tools unchanged.
conditions.S6_goal_paraphrase: One reworded goal per family: a different template and a clinical rewording of the topic. Patient, topic and the reference to the hospital's rules kept; no code, threshold, step, time or answer format added.

runs.settings: --workers 6 --auth subscription, reasoning effort medium, max steps 17, as the locked runs

hypotheses.M1: Under S5, pooled over 3 runs and paired by task, the 95% lower bound of D - B is above -10 points.
hypotheses.M2: D(S5) - D(S0), pooled and paired by task, has a 95% lower bound above -10 points.
hypotheses.P1: D(S6) - D(S0), pooled and paired by task, has a 95% lower bound above -10 points.
hypotheses.P2: D(S6) - B(S0), pooled and paired by task, has a 95% lower bound above -10 points.
hypotheses.descriptive: B(S5) - B(S0) and per-family success, without a threshold.
hypotheses.intervals: Paired by task on the per-task mean over runs (normal approximation), and a family-cluster bootstrap (10 000 resamples, seed 1) as a check, as results/sensitivity-lock/plan.json.
hypotheses.outcomes: passed (primary scorer), passed_upstream and passed_revised as in the main analysis.

content_criteria.G1: A reworded goal names the same patient and the same clinical topic, by a clinical synonym or a rewording, and refers the agent to the hospital's rules.
content_criteria.G2: A reworded goal adds no code, threshold, step, time window, medication name or answer format.
content_criteria.G3: The reworded template shares no run of three or more consecutive words with the locked template.
content_criteria.R1: An S5 terminology entry is the locked entry with its 'Records:' sentence removed and no other change.

smoke_check: Before the lock, D on dev tasks task3_12 and task10_17, once per condition (runs D-dev-smoke-s5, D-dev-smoke-s6; 2 of 2 passed in each), checked only that the variants reach the agent and the run completes; the folders were then deleted. No variant was changed after it.
allowed_changes: None to the variants. A tool or transport failure is rerun with --resume.
reporting: Every condition in this plan is reported with its result, whatever the result.
